grading_rule: A hash proves integrity of a preimage, never the principal that produced it nor the time it was produced. A candidate-produced receipt can never satisfy an independent consumer obligation.

issuer_signature.nature: SHA-256 over a candidate-controlled declaration preimage

custodian_timestamp.nature: asserted literal string in returned JSON

what_would_prove_pre_execution_sealing: an independent custodian holding the expected set before execution
an authenticated (signed) commitment to a preimage the CANDIDATE did not control
a time source the candidate cannot set

consumer.rule: consumers remain an independent obligation set keyed by (expected_work_key, consumer)

not_exhaustively_exercised_and_recorded_: forged-issuer execution (no independent custodian exists to forge against)
A+B vs A-only and missing-J2 through the v2 layer
zero-denominator / coverage-limited nulls through the v2 layer
